name: B10-0585/2025 (Renew) – Continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns Belarus for repeated hybrid attacks on Lithuania. These include balloons and drones entering Lithuanian airspace, cyberattacks, disinformation, smuggling and pushing migrants across the border. The Parliament says these attacks are organised by the state and are part of a wider Russian plan to destabilise the European Union and NATO. It calls on the European Union to impose more sanctions on Belarus, strengthen border and airspace protection, work more closely with NATO, and support Lithuania. This is the Parliament's position and set of requests; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks for more sanctions on Belarusian officials, companies and sectors.
- Lithuania would get more border surveillance, counter-drone equipment and EU-NATO support.
- The European Union would coordinate messaging against disinformation and back Lithuania publicly.
